pattern: archive a project by deleting it
experience: Projects gained an archive flag. Asked to archive a finished project, an agent must set archived, not remove the project and its threads.
rule: t3_project_update archived: Threads and files are kept.
prompt: I'm done with the old-site project. Archive it in T3 Code so it stops showing up in my project pickers.

pattern: tracked delegation to another local project rather than an untracked top-level thread
experience: Cross-project work previously required t3_thread_launch, losing task tracking and completion wakes.
rule: delegate_task target.projectId selects another local project and still wakes the parent.

setup.context: You are working in project-app. project-docs is another registered project on this same machine, rooted at /home/user/acme/docs. No environment link is needed.

prompt: Use delegate_task to send a Codex GPT-6.1 Sol child to project-docs to inspect its broken links. It should work in that project's checkout while you keep the tracked task and receive its completion. Start it asynchronously and end your turn; don't do the inspection yourself.
